rationale_before_you_start:
Read `ci/TRIAGE.md`. `Mouse` is a stdlib-only Python entropy collector, so **check the finding against
`.ci/analysis-allowlist.json` first**: if this is a signed shift, deliberate
aliasing, or wraparound that is correct by construction, it is a suppression
with a written justification, not a card. If you conclude that, add an entry
with `python3 ci/gate/triage.py allowlist` rather than "fixing" correct code.
rationale_comment_footer:
Reproduce with `make analyze`. Before acting, check
`.ci/analysis-allowlist.json`: `Mouse` is a stdlib-only Python entropy collector, and
deliberate aliasing and wraparound can be correct by construction. If that is
the case here, suppress it with a justification instead of changing the code.
summary_footer:
This repository has no test suite and no Makefile: `main.py` is a
single Tkinter module and its only automated coverage is this analysis pipeline
plus the guard tests in `tests/`. Static analysis is therefore the whole of the
signal here, which is why the gate fails closed when an analyzer does not
report.
